info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Research Update API
info.description: The Market Research Update API enables businesses to modify existing market research data efficiently. This API supports operations to adjust parameters pertaining to ongoing market analyses, allowing for timely updates based on new insights or changes in business strategy. Ideal for data analysts and market researchers, this endpoint facilitates precise management of market research records, ensuring that stakeholders have access to the most relevant and up-to-date information. Typical use cases include adjusting research findings, aligning them with current trends, or correcting inaccuracies.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific market research resource identified by its unique ID. It is designed to help businesses refine their market analysis by providing a way to modify existing information as necessary.
